title: 1952 AHSME Problem 15
statement: The sides of a triangle are in the ratio \(6:8:9.\) Then:

answerChoices.label: B
answerChoices.text: The angles are in the ratio \(6:8:9\)

answerChoices.label: D
answerChoices.text:
The angle opposite the largest side is double the angle
opposite the smallest side

solutions.text:
For a triangle with largest side \(9,\) \[ 9^2=81\lt 6^2+8^2=100. \] By the converse of the Pythagorean inequality, the angle opposite side \(9\) is acute. Since it is the largest angle, every angle is acute.

Thus, the correct answer is C.
hints: Compare the square of the largest side with the sum of the squares of the other two
